links.comparator_used: Frozen internally derived model thresholds applied unchanged to the external Stanford Merlin cohort
links.outcome: Macro F1 on external validation cohort
links.effect: Macro F1 0.545 at frozen thresholds, increasing to 0.648 after recalibration; AAA F1 0.889 at frozen thresholds
links.tradeoff: Recalibration needed site-specific data; authors state site-specific threshold calibration is required before clinical deployment. Reduced external operating-point performance at frozen thresholds.
links.quote: On the external Stanford Merlin cohort, macro AUROC was 0.879 with all six classes ≥0.80 ; AAA reached F1 0.889 at frozen thresholds; macro F1 was 0.545, increasing to 0.648 after recalibration.
